messages:
zoe-docs: Heads-up  I opened a small PR to add an "autoscale telemetry" appendix to the Dedicated provisioning guide. It shows how to pull tenant-level metrics (Prometheus & raw API) and a few suggested SLO wording options. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1772. Can the runtime + QA teams skim for accuracy?
marco-eng: on it. Quick question: are we recommending customers scrape Prometheus metrics directly or use our metrics export?
zoe-docs: I added both approaches and a short note about rate limits. Suggest docs prefer the export for large fleets, but include a minimal Prom scrape example for self-hosters.
tara-qa: QA will need the exact metric names and label keys. Please include sample curl + the prometheus query people should use to find tenant-level requests/sec.
sam-product: Legal/product asks we avoid "SLA" phrasing in examples. Use "target SLO" or "observed latency under typical load" as alternatives.
zoe-docs: done. The appendix has two SLO phrasing variants: one for marketing-friendly pages and one technical "observed" phrasing for the handbook.
marco-eng: metric names look OK but change metric 'redwood_requests_total' to 'redwood_inference_requests_total' (we changed prefix earlier). Also label key should be 'redwood.tenant.id' not 'redwood.tenant'.
zoe-docs: updated. I also included this PromQL example:
```
# tenant-level RPS (5m rate)
rate(redwood_inference_requests_total{redwood.tenant.id="tenant-42"}[5m])
```
tara-qa: perfect. Add a quick test step for QA: call the API with a unique test-tenant header and verify the metric increases. I'll paste commands.
zoe-docs: added QA snippet that hits the /v1/infer endpoint with X-Redwood-Tenant header and a basic prompt.
marco-eng: one more runtime note: for Dedicated Private we only export tenant labels if isolation selector present; added a small sentence clarifying that.
zoe-docs: noted. I added a short bullet: "isolation selectors enable per-tenant metrics export" and a troubleshooting tip if you don't see labels.
sam-product: tiny copy nit: change "pin workloads" to "assign affinity" in the examples to match console copy. Also, avoid the word "guarantee".
zoe-docs: changed microcopy and replaced 'guarantee' with 'target SLO' everywhere.
ops-bot: Preview build for PR 1772 available: https://deploys.redwood.com/preview/1772 (expires in 7 days) :construction:
devx-bot: CI: lint OK, linkcheck: 1 warning (external scrape example).
marco-eng: LGTM from runtime after the metric name + label fix. tara-qa: can you run the QA checklist and confirm?
tara-qa: will run today and report back by EOD. If green I can approve.
zoe-docs: thanks all. I'll merge after QA thumbs-up and devx CI passes. Appreciate the quick reviews! :sparkles:
